title: [review] slot_claim.py:170: gateway_iid type coercion
description: If the CBOR "gateway_iid" field is an integer (not bytes), str(iid_bytes) converts it. An integer like 1234567890123456 becomes "1234567890123456" which passes the 16-char and hex validation but represents completely different bytes than intended. CBOR type should be strictly checked.
close_reason: Fixed: from_cbor() now strictly requires gateway_iid to be bytes type in CBOR. Integer/string types that could pass hex validation are rejected with ClaimError. One-line fix: replaced ternary with explicit type check.
